lesson.menu_desc: A dinner with a partner in Austin: talk about what you like and what you want to do -- like + -ing and want to
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 9 -- What Do You Like?
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ender de Souza Batista | Lesson 9 -- What Do You Like?
lesson.grammar_point: like / love / don't like + verb-ing and want to + verb (Do you like...? Do you want to...?)

listenings.text: On weekends, I don't like working. My phone is off! On Saturdays, I like cooking for my friends, and on Sundays I love walking in Central Park. I don't like going to the gym, but I like walking. And next year, I want to learn Portuguese. Many of our partners are in Brazil, and I want to say more than obrigada!

I sit at my computer all day, so after work I love running. I usually run by the river, in the evening. In April, I want to run the London Marathon: forty-two kilometers! When I run, I like listening to music. I love old rock songs, the songs my father likes. I don't like running without music. It is boring.

extra_audio.text: Ender and Jessica are at dinner in Austin. Ender says: I like working out after the office. Jessica says: I love dancing. Ender says: I want to see live music. Jessica asks: Do you want to come to the concert?
